heading.title: Of Contempts of the Lawful Authority of Public Servants

article.title: Refusing oath or affirmation when duly required by public servant to make it
article.content: Whoever refuses to bind himself by an oath or affirmation to state the truth, when required so to bind himself by a public servant legally competent to require that he shall so bind himself, shall be punished with simple imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months, or with fine which may extend to five thousand rupees, or with both.

213Refusing oath or affirmation when duly required by public servant to make it

Section 213 · Chapter XIII

Whoever refuses to bind himself by an oath or affirmation to state the truth, when required so to bind himself by a public servant legally competent to require that he shall so bind himself, shall be punished with simple imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months, or with fine which may extend to five thousand rupees, or with both.
